# Dilemma v3.6.1

Everyone with access to a public player guide can now use Refresh to replace its text with the guide from the running bot version and current server language.

- Keep `/dilemma guide` publishing restricted to Manage Server or the configured Dilemma manager role.
- Refresh the existing public guide without creating another public message or role ping.
- Retain bot-author, server, channel, public-message and component checks so Refresh cannot edit unrelated messages.
- Remove the publishing and refresh instructions from both Polish and English player-guide text.
- Verify ordinary-member refresh, restricted publishing, source-message boundaries, language selection and synchronized guide documents with focused tests.

No database migration or Discord command re-registration is required when upgrading from v3.6.0. After deployment, press Refresh on an existing guide to remove the old paragraph from that message.
